image_urls.description: Organized warehouse shelving for inventory management

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modular Django MVT Distribution Management System (Sistem Distribusi Barang) with two roles: Admin and User. Implement core workflows: Products (Barang), Stock & Warehouse (Stok), Requests (Permintaan), Approval/Rejection workflow (Persetujuan), Distribution & Status Tracking Timeline (Distribusi & Tracking), and internal notifications in Bahasa Indonesia. Use MySQL via environment variable. Include pre-populated demo accounts for Admin and User. Ensure modern enterprise light UI with sidebar and data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
